cover.how_to_read_lead: Each tab stands alone. Each page stands alone.
how_to_read: Pages are short on purpose. Facts first. No filler.
Registers come first in each tab. Detail pages follow, one per item.
Dates are shown as month, day, year.
Where two records disagree, both are kept with a note saying so.
Dollar amounts are exact. Credits are shown in parentheses.
Tab 11 ties every RFI with a cost to its PCO.

summary.subtitle: The job on one page
summary.headline: Replace 2 rooftop HVAC units and curbs. Add new controls. Keep the school open the whole time.
status_bullets: Both new curbs are set and dried in.
RTU-1 and RTU-2 were delivered March 2 and are stored on site.
RFI 001 (curb out of level) is answered. The fix is PCO 001.
Submittals for the units and controls are approved.
Two PCOs are approved, one is pending.
Unit set is planned for the spring break week.
scope_rows: Remove 2 rooftop units. Furnish and set 2 new units on new curbs.
New curbs and adapters at both units. Roof tie in by the roofing sub.
New thermostats and building automation tie in for both units.
New disconnects and feeders by Sample Electric.
Factory startup, test and balance, owner training.
O&M manuals, warranty matrix, as built drawings.
